title: Chapter 419 - 419 Studying; My Lil White!

Chapter 419 - 419 Studying; My Lil White!

Chapter 419 - 419 Studying; My Lil White!

419 Studying; My Lil White!

Lin Fan had Professor-Level Computer Science Experience.

At the same time, he also had Professional Hacking Skills.

Writing a relatively complicated program was nothing.

Xia Bing and Xia Xue felt the warm aura from Lin Fan’s body, and their faces turned red.

After a while, they stuttered, “Okay… Alright.”

Then, Lin Fan looked at Liu Qianqian and asked, “What kind of research are you good at?”

Liu Qianqian thought for a moment and said, “Electromagnetism.”

Lin Fan nodded. He picked up a pen and paper and quickly wrote down a few problems.

“I’ll try to answer them.”

In the end, Lin Fan’s gaze landed on Nie Zhenjiang.

“What are you good at?”

“The Navier-Stokes equation,” Nie Zhenjiang said.

When Jiang Chaoqun, Liu Qianqian, Hao Zhiwu, and the others heard this, they all looked at him in surprise.

Even though they did not major in mathematics, they also knew that the Navier-Stokes equation was one of the Millennium Prize Problems. No one had been able to solve it for hundreds of years.

Nie Zhenjiang was good at the Navier-Stokes equations!

“Not bad, Zhenjiang!” Hao Zhiwu said directly. “You’re actually studying one of the Millennium Prize Problems! Which step are you at now?”

Nie Zhenjiang blushed.

Which step had his research reached?

He was just an ordinary university student. How far could he go?

He had just gotten started.

Lin Fan did not care about it and wrote down equations and problems.

Nie Zhenjiang looked at Lin Fan’s elegant handwriting and complicated calculations. He was in a daze.

At this moment, he suddenly remembered the scene of Lin Fan participating in the mathematical modeling competition with him.

At that time, Nie Zhenjiang was determined to win the Higher Education Cup.

In the end, it was given to Lin Fan.

Regarding this…

Nie Zhenjiang had been brooding over this.

He felt that it was all because Lin Fan had solved Zhou’s Conjecture.

That was why the judges gave the Higher Education Cup to Lin Fan.

Now, it seemed that he was really too narrow-minded.

Lin Fan saw that Nie Zhenjiang was in a daze and not saying anything. He could not help but ask, “Don’t you understand? Should I change the topics to something simpler?”

Nie Zhenjiang’s face became redder and redder. He hurriedly said, “No need, no need.”

Lin Fan nodded his head. “Alright, then try to think of the answers. If you don’t understand anything, you can ask me.”

Everyone responded.

It had to be said that these people were indeed talents from famous universities.

They all had extremely strong self-control.

Not long after, they moved a large pile of books from the library and quickly flipped through them. They kept taking notes and making calculations.

Suddenly, the sound of books being flipped and the crisp sound of pen tips colliding with the table could be heard in the office.

An ordinary person could focus on studying for half an hour or an hour…

However, these people maintained an extremely focused learning attitude almost all day long other than when they had to take their meals and visit the toilet.

The originally empty draft books were now filled with countless complicated patterns and calculations.

This state lasted for three days.

When everyone was tired and ready to go home, Hao Zhiwu suddenly said, “Professor Lin, can I bring Lil White here?”

“Lil White?” Lin Fan asked curiously.

As soon as he finished speaking, the super smart watch on his wrist flashed slightly.

However, it did not respond.

It was because it knew that there were many other people here.

“It’s my cat. I’ve been keeping it in the dormitory for the past few days, so it’s a little bored.”

“Of course, this isn’t the main reason,” he explained further. “The main reason is that when I’m with Lil White, my learning efficiency will increase by a lot.”

Bringing a cat to Lin Fan’s office.

In the past few days, Hao Zhiwu, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Nie Zhenjiang, Liu Qianqian, and Jiang Chaoqun had been reading and studying.

Lin Fan spent every day in his chair playing with his phone and laptop. He occasionally looked out the window. He was really bored.

If there was a cat in the office, it would be nice to pet it.

Thus, Lin Fan nodded. “Alright, bring it over, then.”

“Alright!” Hao Zhiwu said happily,

…

The next day…

Nie Zhenjiang, Liu Qianqian, Jiang Chaoqun, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, Hao Zhiwu, and the others all arrived at the office on time.

On Hao Zhiwu’s shoulder was a white cat.

“Is this Lil White?” Liu Qianqian asked. “It’s so white and chubby. How cute. It’s actually still lying on your shoulder without moving at all. How obedient.”

After three days of getting along, the few of them were basically familiar with each other and would occasionally chat.

“Of course!” Hao Zhiwu said proudly. “My Lil White likes to lie on my shoulder. If I don’t carry it down, it can continue to lie on my shoulder!”

“It’s that obedient?” Liu Qianqian asked in surprise. “Can I hold it?”

“I’m afraid that won’t do,” Hao Zhiwu said apologetically. “My Lil White is very attached to me. It only wants to be hugged by me.”

At this moment, Lin Fan walked in slowly.

Hao Zhiwu, Xu Qianqian, Xia Bing, Xia Xue, and the others quickly greeted, “Hello, Professor Lin.”

Lin Fan nodded and said, “Hello.”

As they spoke, the cat also let out two clear meows.

To Hao Zhiwu, Liu Qianqian, and the others, the cat’s meows were crisp and pleasant.

When Lin Fan heard the cat’s meows, a strange look appeared on his face.

It was because Lin Fan had the skill—Animal Communication. He could understand the language of all animals and communicate with them.

The little cat asked, “The poop-shoveler has been here these few days? It doesn’t look like there’s anything delicious here!

“Then why have I been making a scene at home these past few days?”

Lin Fan smiled and opened a bag of premium beef cat food that he had spent 1,000 yuan on last night at the supermarket. He said, “Lil White, I have delicious food here. Come over quickly.”

The cat did not hesitate at all. It jumped down from Hao Zhiwu’s shoulder and walked toward Lin Fan.

Seeing this…

Liu Qianqian, Jiang Chaoqun, and the others all looked at Hao Zhiwu.

They looked as if they were asking him, ‘Didn’t you say that it’ll refuse to come down from your shoulder?’

At this moment, the cat had already arrived in front of Lin Fan. It was eating the top-grade beef cat food in Lin Fan’s hands, and its mouth could not help but let out a series of gurgling sounds.

“It’s so delicious. I’ve never eaten such delicious food before!

“It’s so delicious!”

Lin Fan smiled, “Come, let me hug you. I have a lot of good food here.”

The cat did not hesitate at all and jumped into Lin Fan’s arms. It made a series of purring sounds to please him.

“Master, can you be my new master?”

Seeing this…

Liu Qianqian, Jiang Chaoqun, and the others looked at Hao Zhiwu again.

It was as if they were saying… ‘Is this what you meant by it’s only attached to you?’
